rule:activated-plus1-counter-transfer-fr.definition: An activated ability removes a +1/+1 counter from the SOURCE and places it onto another target creature. Direction is source -> other; both members (Spike Hatcher, Spike Rogue) read 'Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.'
rule:activated-plus1-counter-transfer-fr.why: D1 -- name and definition asserted the reverse of what both members do

merges.why: D2 -- identical mechanic; all four members carry the same printed text. Grammar section 1 design goal 1. `defending-player` is the CR-correct term.

rule:redirects-damage-from-controller-to.definition: A static ability redirects damage that would be dealt to the controller onto this permanent instead -- a lightning rod. Opposite direction from rule:redirects-combat-damage-to-controller-and-self, and distinct from rule:prevents-damage-to-self, which prevents rather than redirects.

rule:activated-redirect-damage-from-self.definition: An activated ability redirects the next damage that would be dealt to this permanent so it is dealt to any target instead. Distinct from rule:redirect-damage-to-spell-controller, which is restricted to instant/sorcery damage and sends it back at that spell's controller.

rule:activated-prevent-combat-damage-unb.definition: An activated ability, paid by returning the permanent to its owner's hand, prevents combat damage that would be dealt by a target unblocked creature this turn.
rule:activated-prevent-combat-damage-unb.note: D3d -- the ACTIVATED sibling. Grammar section 1: DELIVERY is omitted for spell abilities, so the unmarked slug belongs to the instant (Snag) and the activated card takes the marked prefix.

rule:lifegain-scales-with-target-color-c.definition: The controller gains life scaled to the number of colors of the TARGET itself, not to a count of permanents on the battlefield.
rule:lifegain-scales-with-target-color-c.note: D3e -- distinct stat from section 7's `color-count`, which is a board count.

moves.why: D3a -- Weathered Bodyguards redirects INCOMING damage onto itself, the reverse of the axis
D3b -- Mirrorwood Treefolk matches neither the source restriction nor the destination
D3c -- Chittering Dispatcher is a SELF leaves-battlefield trigger with no once-per-turn limit
D3d -- Gossamer Chains is the ACTIVATED ability; the unmarked slug is the spell's
D3e -- Breathe Your Last scales with the TARGET's colors, not a board count

drops.why: Zoo Escapees triggers on LEAVING the battlefield, not entering; it is correctly homed on rule:leaves-battlefield-trigger-create-token-mutagen. Open C2 drift finding.

rule:activated-counters-target-spell.55c71732-6ba1-401d-8759-4d64dae22133: {U}: Counter target spell with the chosen name.

rule:activated-tap-or-untap-any-permanen.55765934-07be-4f03-a2e8-8292c0b601ae: {T}: You may tap or untap another target permanent.

rule:death-trigger-scroll-regrowth.3cd9bac9-0abc-43d8-9f84-94f965f7a2e0: When Cormela dies, return up to one target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.

rule:energy-outlet-condition.9373a176-a5e9-4fdc-906b-bc6aef657e5b: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {E}{E}. If you do, create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.
rule:energy-outlet-condition.dbb6b7f0-33fd-4530-a621-114148fb3929: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {E}{E}. If you do, it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

rule:leaves-battlefield-trigger-create-t.9087928a-4732-4661-b3ed-d0b1ea06edf6: When this creature leaves the battlefield, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

rule:leaves-battlefield-trigger-create-t.107e9ada-4e2e-4032-addd-274bca956621: When this creature leaves the battlefield, create a Mutagen token.

definition_edits.rule:conditional-attack-restriction-by-d: The creature can't attack unless the defending player controls a land of a specified type. Absorbed rule:conditional-attack-restriction-by-opponent-land-type (D2): the two described one mechanic, and `defending-player` is the CR-correct term -- `opponent` is wrong in multiplayer, since the restriction is templated on the defender.
definition_edits.rule:prevent-combat-damage-unblocked-cre: A SPELL prevents combat damage that would be dealt by unblocked creatures this turn. DELIVERY is unmarked because it is a spell ability (grammar section 1, CR 113.3a); the activated-ability form is rule:activated-prevent-combat-damage-unblocked-creature.
definition_edits.rule:postcombat-main-phase-trigger: A triggered ability that fires at the beginning of a postcombat main phase, rather than at end of turn or in the precombat main. Covers both the controller-only form (Florian) and the every-player form (Belbe); whose phase it is does not change the mechanic.
definition_edits.rule:combat-damage-to-player-proliferate: Whenever a creature deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, the controller proliferates. A condition gating the proliferate (Vexing Radgull) is a per-card detail, not part of the axis.
